name: Brave C&H Supply Co.,Ltd.
summary: Brave C&H Supply Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells precision screens and screen-printing materials in Taiwan and China. It provides plate cleaner, stainless steel mesh, teflon, nylon mesh, dust-free wiping cloth, solar-powered carbon fiber scraper, tension meter, peeling powder, wire frames, filler, degreasing agent, high-sensitivity photosensitive emulsion, and scrapers; filter belt and filter cloth; and pad printing consumables. The company also offers screen printing products for solar energy, photoelectric, biotechnology sector, as well as offers passive components. Brave C&H Supply Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
